scenes.desc: Pulse line + stats: 3 cohorts / 17 tutors / ~160 students / ...and 47 group chats.
Notification/chat-bubble chaos piles up, freezes at 16.0, implodes 17-18.
DROP. DSBA Pulse logo reveal: 'DSBA, rebuilt from scratch.' + 4 pills.
Feature 1 - The Pulse newsletter in a 3D browser frame, callouts, issue covers.
Feature 2 - Forum: threads fly in, votes tick, composer types, replies, easter egg.
Fast montage of the rest of v2: library + file viewer, lessons, calendar, grades, search; then cohorts network + 'Built by students.'
'Launching today' + LAUNCH button + 3/2/1 countdown + click at 63.85.
Glitch #1: freeze, corruption, error windows, static, black.
SURPRISE! Happy Birthday card for the admin, confetti, cake; music-box song.
Glitch #2: song cut on final 'you', scramble, terminal 'wrong target', crescendo, flash, black+silence.
Letter to the tutors, typed line by line over soft piano; riser into the drop.
DROP: HAPPY TEACHER'S DAY, gold, particles.
17 tutor names appear on beats, then 'Thank you.'
Constellation pull-back, sign-off, fade to black.
